### 1 — Scene
A breakfast tray: toast and a fried egg on the larger plate, a toasted breakfast sandwich on the smaller plate, and a mug of milky tea or coffee.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 24 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 12² = **452 cm²**.
- **Side plate:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² = **314 cm²**. It is centrally on the same tray, so I include it.
- **Mug:** approximately 7.5 cm internal diameter.

### 3 — Visible items
Toast, fried egg, a toasted muffin-style sandwich with apparent egg and cheese filling, and a milky hot drink. The sandwich filling is partly obscured. Sealed condiment packets are excluded because their contents and consumption are not visible. No separately measurable oil or butter is apparent.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
For the sandwich, the overlapping layers share the same footprint; their coverage is counted only once.

| Item | Vessel coverage / area | Height | Gross volume | Density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Toast | Main: 43% / 194 cm² | 1.2 cm | 233 ml | 0.30 | 70 g | 270 | 189 kcal |
| Fried egg | Main: 14% / 63 cm² | 0.8 cm | 50 ml | 0.98 | 49 g | 195 | 96 kcal |
| Sandwich bread | Side: 25% / 79 cm² | 1.6 cm combined | 126 ml | 0.30 | 38 g | 250 | 95 kcal |
| Sandwich egg filling | Same 79 cm² footprint | 0.7 cm | 55 ml | 0.95 | 52 g | 155 | 81 kcal |
| Apparent cheese filling | Same 79 cm² footprint | 0.2 cm | 16 ml | 1.00 | 16 g | 400 | 64 kcal |
| Milky tea or coffee | Mug cross-section: 44 cm² | 5 cm liquid depth | 220 ml | 1.00 | 220 g | 15 | 33 kcal |

**Coverage check:** approximately **57% of the main plate** and **25% of the side plate** are covered by food.

### 8 — Sanity check
The solid food totals approximately **225 g and 525 kcal**, plausible for two toast slices, an egg, and a small breakfast sandwich. Including the drink gives approximately **445 g and 558 kcal**. The sandwich filling and milk quantity are the largest uncertainties.
